title: Dither an image with a blue noise texture
userPaths: A user dithers an image against a blue-noise texture, producing a two-color PNG

checks.path: A user dithers an image against a blue-noise texture, producing a two-color PNG

preconditions: blue-noise.png at the repo root is the noise texture used by the check.
gotchas: The output directory (-o) must already exist; the CLI does not create it.
